#!/bin/sh
generate
uv run lintro fmt generated.py
lintro fmt generated.mjs
uv run lintro format .
prettier --check generated.css
ruff check --fix generated.py
buf lint generated.proto
taplo check Cargo.toml
sqlfluff lint generated.sql
echo prettier --write generated.css
# bunx oxfmt generated.mjs
# example; black generated.py
  # execSync('black generated.py');
myblack generated.py
oxfmt-helper generated.mjs
# Biome has no builtin FORMAT declaration in this Lintro release.
biome format generated.js
biome check --write generated.js
